sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: occupant protection, vehicle condition and starting the car
Knowledge facts: part C holds 46 fact blocks (sec04-F01 onward) from physical pages 42 to 52; part C2 holds 27 confusable and continuation blocks (sec04-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the 2026 manual, the 50-question count and the 80 percent (40 of 50) passing standard from physical pages 32 and 33; the time limit is unknown.
VERIFY list:
- NJ-BELT-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NJ-BELT-D-UNDERTWO — whether the youngest child-seat rule needs both the age and the weight condition (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- NJ-BELT-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- NJ-BELT-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: child passenger, snow and ice and idling fines, the child seat help line, the federal auto safety hotline and websites (for example sec04-F19, sec04-F46) can change and must be refreshed from official agency websites.

corpus_stability.reason: The New Jersey Driver Manual prints 2026 on its front cover and a single back-cover code; the identification charts carry one revision note (Revised 4/2026) and the manual says fees are subject to change, with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.
